findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "technical-analysis" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: technical-analysis_macd, technical-analysis_strategy-backtest · Public sink: technical-analysis_moving-averages, technical-analysis_momentum-oscillators, technical-analysis_macd, technical-analysis_bands-channels, technical-analysis_volatility-measures, technical-analysis_ichimoku, technical-analysis_trend-indicators, technical-analysis_volume-indicators, technical-analysis_volume-profile, technical-analysis_pivot-points, technical-analysis_fibonacci-levels, technical-analysis_candlestick-patterns, technical-analysis_chart-patterns, technical-analysis_support-resistance, technical-analysis_strategy-backtest · Destructive: technical-analysis_moving-averages, technical-analysis_momentum-oscillators, technical-analysis_macd, technical-analysis_bands-channels, technical-analysis_volatility-measures, technical-analysis_ichimoku, technical-analysis_trend-indicators, technical-analysis_volume-indicators, technical-analysis_volume-profile, technical-analysis_pivot-points, technical-analysis_fibonacci-levels, technical-analysis_candlestick-patterns, technical-analysis_chart-patterns, technical-analysis_support-resistance, technical-analysis_strategy-backtest.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
